findings: resolved-at-requirements-level (major, XDL1-RVW-001): the predecessor's ExperimentLimits.max_parameters total-plan bound was declared 'per payload and total compiled parameters' but only enforced per payload. XDL1-SR-019 now requires each declared bound to be enforced over its full declared scope (including a total-plan scope where the design declares one) and XDL1-SR-014 now makes any declared library-bound violation a rejection that yields no plan of any kind. The successor design/implementation/validation stages must implement and re-verify this; no code or test was repaired in this stage.

resolved-at-requirements-level (major, XDL1-RVW-002): the predecessor froze a Component/System core-parameter mapping but silently dropped System.spec.parameters from every plan section. XDL1-SR-002 now requires every declared core parameter of the selected System and of each referenced Component to be projected by the frozen concept-to-field mapping, with an explicit no-silent-omission acceptance criterion.

resolved-at-requirements-level (major, XDL1-RVW-003): XDL1-PLAN-BOUND-EXCEEDED was the only frozen diagnostic code with no test and no count-based bound had a negative case. XDL1-SR-019 now requires at least one independent negative case per declared library bound (including the total compiled-parameter bound), and XDL1-SR-012 requires the limitation-count bound to be enforced and negatively covered.
